name: issue-implementation-planning
description: Orchestrates GitHub issue intake, ask-first implementation planning, and plan refinement. Use with an issue number or URL. Planning only unless the user explicitly requests implementation.

inputs.name: issue-reference
inputs.description: Issue number or full GitHub issue URL.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: Optional target repository as owner/name when not inferable.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers accumulated across clarification loops.

outputs.name: refined-implementation-plan
outputs.description: Final markdown implementation plan after refinement.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list of remaining questions after refinement.
